<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant monoisotopic peak at m/z 127.10 followed by a series of M+1, M+2, … peaks with rapidly decreasing intensities that match the expected 13C distribution—we can definitively identify carbon as the element responsible for the pattern. No characteristic Cl, Br, S, or other element patterns are present.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
